title: The preview dialog of a template card (JA Impact) asks for no design system file and no copy file under the template's id
steps: S1: Mount the real PreviewDialog on a template card (id ja-impact, with a template) with fetch recording every address asked; let the first requests settle.
S2: Mount it on a design system card (id sys-alpha) the same way.
expect: S1: no request names /systems/ja-impact or /copy/ja-impact (before the fix: components.html, slots, copy, system/artifacts/landing.html, artifact-slots/landing — five 404s per open, reported by Chrome as CORS).
S2: the design system's own components.html and copy are still asked for.
fence: PreviewDialog: a template card fetches no fixture, slot map, artifact or copy file (isSystem)

tests: sweep 9: a template card asks for no design system file and no copy file under its id
sweep 9: a design system card still asks for its own fixture, slots and copy
